notes.title: 3.76003 - Displays Rebalanced
notes.content:
[b]Main Changes:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced many desserts Display Multipliers and Speeds. For most desserts, you will see an increase in gems. 

NOTE: Because of this, the validation process may reset and re-apply your dessert LVL XP based on your trainer settings on first time entering/franchising each store. This may cause a slight bit more delay on first time through.

[*] Increased the cap size of Cupcake and Cake stores from 1.2x and 1.6x to 1.5x and 2.0x respectively.
[*] Removed suggestions from out of currency popups and + signs on currency which suggested that you could purchase them in the store. 

[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where with keep XP /LEVELs perk caused the stores to lose their upgrade spending when franchising. 
[*] Fixed an issue where respec slightly reduced quality ratio from intended. 
[*] Fixed an issue where sometimes Specialty points like sugar, flour and butter were reverted in stores. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the total and count of the HQ upgrades unlocked displayed in corporate was wrong. 
[*] Fixed the text for display manager incorrectly stating each store needed 5 franchises.
 [/list]

notes.content:
BUG FIXES:
* If you were in the top 10 or bottom 10 the rankings on leaderboard didn't always display correctly.
* fixed a bug where the green arrow to go back to top shifted tasks over in portrait mode. 
* fixed a bug where sometimes after selling a store the icons colours for the trainer remain even if you didn't have it purchased yet. 
* fixed a bug where the desserts filters didn't saved consistently. Now they both save per store.

CHANGES:
* Removed support for iOS cross platform saves. (should still function for now, but may be disabled moving forward)
* Removed IAP for currency. The IAP for currency made some users incorrectly assume that the gameplay was designed to require these purchases when in reality they are easily attainable through exploration of the mechanics such as the Display Cabinets.

notes.title: 3.5 Update + Doopwee Days
notes.content:
3.5 FEATURES / ADJUSTMENTS:
:star: 8 new end game perks added to the HQ Perks
:star: Return from offline popup now shows tickets earned / times franchised from CEO
:star: Added a new button to recipes to allow disabling of Head Managers purchases
:star: Added the ability to revert back to a previous 4 past saves as backups accessible through the main settings.
ːsteamthisː Time in coporate or processing multiple franchises is now averaged reducing time spent loading/processing 
ːsteamthisː Adjusted the Managers so the amount they apply also are factored in the percentages based on the stores specialties
ːsteamthisː New button animations and sounds on hover
ːsteamthisː New ping sounds added for notifications like speed up ready and display sold
ːsteamthisː Save state of corporate so next load boot back directly in.
ːsteamthisː Desserts now prioritize favourited desserts for processing order then go by active sort order.
ːsteamthisː When using the store conversion of gems to coins, the game now buffers the coins until a full loop or processing of recipes so that priority is given to the active sort order.
ːsteamthisː Improved the time it takes for offline processing in general.
ːsteamthisː Added new buttons to the HQ Perks to buy max XP gems from both gems and tickets.
ːsteamthisː Added ability to buy entire chain of perks by purchasing the final perk in the chain.
ːsteamthisː Added ability to delete cloud account through the settings menu
:hammer: Multiple Bug Fixes.

In Addition to this, Doopwee Days is live now which is the best time to get all dessert recipes from previous events in addition to the rare Doopwee Recipes.

Don't forget to join the Discord to discuss strategies or ask questions:  
[url=https://discord.gg/NKsk7TnNze ] Join the Discord[/url]
